name: Integumentum commune (body surface)
function: The body surface. Carries no anatomical data of its own in this atlas; it exists so that every other structure can be measured against the skin -- needle depth, entry point, safe corridor -- which is what an injection plan starts from. Geometry from the Visible Human male colour cryosections (tissue silhouette).
source: Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998) for the name; geometry: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male cryosections via the NCI Imaging Data Commons.
